function makeSFVignetteNode(TSL): FnNode<[ProxiedObject<SFVignetteNodeArgs>], Node<'vec4'>>

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/post-nodes.ts:38

Builds the vignette node used at the end of the post chain.

Math: d = |uv − 0.5|·2 → 0 at center, ~1.41 at corners. v = 1 − |d|·offset, clamped → linear falloff scaled by reach. factor = mix(1, v^darkness, min(darkness,1)) → darkness doubles as curve exponent and amount so a single value feels photographic.
